name: qq-mail
description: QQ Mail (QQ 邮箱, mail.qq.com) connector via the official IMAP / SMTP / Exchange protocols. Provides the 'qq-mail' app connection for plugins that read, search, send, and organize messages across @qq.com / @foxmail.com / vip.qq.com mailboxes.

setup.label: QQ 邮箱地址 (例如 123456789@qq.com / user@foxmail.com / user@vip.qq.com)
QQ 邮箱授权码 (不是 QQ 密码, 在 mail.qq.com → 设置 → 账户 → POP3/IMAP/SMTP/Exchange/CardDAV/CalDAV服务 中开启并生成)
IMAP 服务器地址 (默认 imap.qq.com, Foxmail 同此)
SMTP 服务器地址 (默认 smtp.qq.com)
SMTP 端口 (SSL 465 或 STARTTLS 587, 默认 465)

interface.shortDescription: QQ Mail (QQ 邮箱, mail.qq.com) connector via the official IMAP / SMTP / Exchange protocols. Provides the 'qq-mail' app connection for plugins that read, search, send, and organize messages across @qq.com / @foxmail.com / vip.qq.com mailboxes.
interface.longDescription: QQ Mail (QQ 邮箱) connector via the official IMAP / SMTP / Exchange endpoints published at https://service.mail.qq.com/. QQ Mail does NOT expose a public OpenAPI; the supported integration path is standard mail protocols authenticated by an authorization code (授权码) generated in mail.qq.com settings. Operations are dispatched through the connector registered as 'qq-mail' in the duya AppConnectorRegistry. The connector handles IMAP IDLE for push, SMTP submission for sending, and Exchange ActiveSync if enabled. Use this connector to list folders, search / read / send messages, manage contacts, and organize @qq.com / @foxmail.com / @vip.qq.com mailboxes.
